name: Consumer Electronics
description: Questions covering: Smartphones, Laptops, Tablet Computers, Televisions, Headphones...

questions.question: Which mobile operating system was developed by Apple for its smartphones?
questions.explanation_correct: iOS is Apple's mobile operating system used on iPhones. It is the correct match for the clue.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are mobile operating systems from different companies or eras. They are not developed by Apple.

questions.question: What is the name of Apple’s laptop product line?
questions.explanation_correct: MacBook is Apple’s line of laptops. It is the correct product line named in the clue.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are laptop or computer lines from other manufacturers. They are not Apple’s laptop line.

questions.question: Which tablet family is sold under Amazon’s own brand?
questions.explanation_correct: Fire is Amazon’s tablet brand. It includes devices such as the Fire HD tablets.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are tablet brands made by Samsung, Apple, and Google. They are not Amazon tablets.

questions.question: Which display technology uses liquid crystals to modulate light from a backlight in many televisions?
questions.explanation_correct: An LCD uses liquid crystals to modulate light; many LCD televisions use an LED backlight.
questions.explanation_incorrect: OLED is self-emissive, plasma uses gas cells and CRT uses an electron beam.

questions.question: Which wireless earbuds are sold under Apple’s AirPods brand?
questions.explanation_correct: AirPods are Apple's wireless earbuds. They are the named line referenced by the clue.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Beats Fit Pro are sold under the Beats brand, which is also owned by Apple. Galaxy Buds and Pixel Buds are Samsung and Google lines.

questions.question: Which Nintendo console was designed to work both as a handheld and connected to a TV dock?
questions.explanation_correct: The Nintendo Switch is Nintendo’s hybrid console that can be used handheld or docked. It matches the clue exactly.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are older Nintendo systems with different designs and purposes. They are not the hybrid console described.

questions.question: What is Samsung’s smartwatch line called?
questions.explanation_correct: Galaxy Watch is Samsung’s smartwatch line. It is the correct brand name for the clue.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are smartwatch lines made by Apple, Fitbit, and Garmin. They are not Samsung’s watches.

questions.question: Which voice assistant is used in Amazon Echo devices?
questions.explanation_correct: Alexa is Amazon’s voice assistant found in Echo smart speakers. It is the correct answer to the clue.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are voice assistants associated with different companies. They are not the assistant used in Echo devices.

questions.question: What is Amazon’s e-reader brand called?
questions.explanation_correct: Kindle is Amazon’s e-reader brand. It is used for Amazon’s line of reading devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are e-reader brands from different companies. They are not Amazon’s Kindle line.

questions.question: Which wireless technology includes the A2DP profile commonly used to stream audio to headphones?
questions.explanation_correct: A2DP is a Bluetooth profile for distributing audio, including music to compatible headphones.
questions.explanation_incorrect: NFC can assist pairing and Wi-Fi can stream audio, but A2DP is a Bluetooth profile; Zigbee targets other low-power networking uses.

questions.question: Which camera maker is known for the EOS line?
questions.explanation_correct: Canon is the company behind the EOS family of digital cameras. The EOS name is strongly associated with Canon's interchangeable-lens camera systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also camera brands, but they are not the maker of the EOS line.

questions.question: Which Google product line included HDMI devices called Chromecast for streaming and casting to TVs?
questions.explanation_correct: Chromecast is Google's streaming dongle brand. It is used to cast or stream content to a TV.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other choices are streaming-device brands or products, but they are not Google's Chromecast.

questions.question: Which Meta headset family includes standalone devices such as Quest 3?
questions.explanation_correct: Quest headsets are Meta’s standalone VR and mixed-reality devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Rift was also a Meta/Oculus headset family, but Quest includes the standalone Quest 3. Index and Vive are associated with Valve and HTC.

questions.question: Which company makes the Osmo Action camera line?
questions.explanation_correct: Osmo Action is DJI’s action-camera line.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other companies sell cameras, but Osmo Action is a DJI line.

questions.question: Which Apple media player line is being referenced?
questions.explanation_correct: The iPod was Apple's portable media player line. It became one of the company's most recognizable consumer electronics products.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are Apple products, but they are not the portable music player line.

questions.question: Which Samsung smartphone family uses names such as Galaxy S24?
questions.explanation_correct: Galaxy S is Samsung's flagship smartphone line. It represents the company's top-tier mainstream phone series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Galaxy A is another Samsung line; Pixel and Xperia are Google and Sony brands. Galaxy S24 belongs to the Galaxy S family.

questions.question: Which company is the manufacturer associated with the PlayStation console family?
questions.explanation_correct: Sony manufactures the PlayStation family of game consoles. The brand is closely tied to Sony's gaming hardware.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are console manufacturers, but they are not the company behind PlayStation.

questions.question: Which term is used for quantum-dot-enhanced LCD televisions such as Samsung QLED models?
questions.explanation_correct: QLED TVs commonly use quantum dots with an LCD panel and a backlight; QLED is not a synonym for self-emissive OLED.
questions.explanation_incorrect: OLED uses organic light-emitting layers, plasma uses gas cells and CRT uses a cathode-ray tube.

questions.question: Which brand sells the MOMENTUM 4 Wireless headphones?
questions.explanation_correct: MOMENTUM 4 Wireless is part of Sennheiser’s MOMENTUM headphone family.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Bose, Sony and JBL also sell headphones, but not the Sennheiser MOMENTUM line.

questions.question: Which company introduced the Era 100 wireless home speaker?
questions.explanation_correct: Era 100 is a Sonos smart speaker that can be used in a multiroom audio system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Bose, JBL and Denon also sell audio equipment, but Era 100 is a Sonos product.

questions.question: Which instant camera brand is known for popularizing instant film photography?
questions.explanation_correct: Polaroid is the classic instant camera brand most closely associated with instant film photography. It became a defining name in the category.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are camera or imaging brands, but they are not the iconic instant camera brand in question.

questions.question: Which company produces the Mavic drone family?
questions.explanation_correct: DJI makes the Mavic family of camera drones.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Parrot, Skydio and Yuneec also make drones, but the Mavic line belongs to DJI.

questions.question: Which fitness tracker company introduced the Fitbit Charge series?
questions.explanation_correct: Charge is a Fitbit family of wearable activity trackers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Garmin, Withings and Xiaomi make wearables, but the Charge series is a Fitbit line.

questions.question: Which e-reader brand is owned by the Japanese company Rakuten?
questions.explanation_correct: Kobo is a Canadian company acquired by the Japanese tech giant Rakuten in 2012.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Kindle is owned by Amazon, Nook is owned by Barnes & Noble, and Onyx is a separate brand.

questions.question: Which brand sells the Smart Thermostat Premium?
questions.explanation_correct: Smart Thermostat Premium is an ecobee product for compatible home heating and cooling systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Nest, Honeywell and Tado also sell thermostats, but Smart Thermostat Premium is an ecobee model.

questions.question: Which laptop family was introduced by IBM and later became a Lenovo product line?
questions.explanation_correct: ThinkPad began at IBM; Lenovo acquired IBM’s PC business and continued the line.
questions.explanation_incorrect: ZenBook is an ASUS family, EliteBook an HP family, and Latitude a Dell family.

questions.question: Which product family is Microsoft’s line of Windows tablets and 2-in-1 PCs?
questions.explanation_correct: Surface is Microsoft’s hardware family, including Windows tablets and 2-in-1 PCs. Some distinct Surface Duo devices used Android.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Galaxy Tab, iPad and MediaPad are product lines associated with Samsung, Apple and Huawei.

questions.question: Which early consumer PC-based virtual reality headset was a joint venture between HTC and Valve?
questions.explanation_correct: The original HTC Vive was a consumer PC VR headset developed with technology and collaboration from Valve.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Valve Index is a Valve headset, Quest is associated with Meta, and Pico is a separate headset brand.

questions.question: Which company sells the Ultra and Streaming Stick TV streaming players?
questions.explanation_correct: Roku sells streaming players including Roku Ultra and Roku Streaming Stick.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Apple TV, Fire TV and Chromecast are competing product families from Apple, Amazon and Google.

questions.question: What name replaced Android Pay when Google consolidated its payment brands in 2018?
questions.explanation_correct: Google introduced the Google Pay brand in 2018 to bring together Android Pay and Google Wallet. Branding and services have since evolved.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Apple Pay, Samsung Pay and PayPal were not the name Google adopted for that 2018 consolidation.

questions.question: Which mobile operating system was developed by Google?
questions.explanation_correct: Android is developed under Google’s leadership; Google acquired Android Inc. before releasing the platform.
questions.explanation_incorrect: iOS is Apple’s, HarmonyOS is Huawei’s, and Windows Phone was Microsoft’s mobile platform.

questions.question: Which wireless earbud brand is made by Samsung?
questions.explanation_correct: Galaxy Buds are Samsung's wireless earbuds line. They are marketed under the Galaxy brand.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are wireless earbud brands from other companies. They are not Samsung's earbuds line.

questions.question: Which e-reader line is sold by Barnes & Noble?
questions.explanation_correct: Nook is Barnes & Noble's e-reader line. It includes dedicated e-readers and related apps.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are e-reader brands from different companies. They are not Barnes & Noble's line.

questions.question: Which mixed reality headset is made by Apple?
questions.explanation_correct: Vision Pro is Apple's mixed reality headset. It combines virtual and augmented reality features.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are headsets from other manufacturers. They are not Apple's mixed reality device.

questions.question: Which series of wearable devices was launched in 2015, featuring the S-series SIP and watchOS?
questions.explanation_correct: Apple Watch debuted in 2015, uses watchOS and integrates with iPhone.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Galaxy Watch, Fitbit Sense and Pixel Watch are wearable lines associated with other companies.

questions.question: Which portable speaker brand is known for the Flip and Charge lines?
questions.explanation_correct: JBL is known for portable speakers such as the Flip and Charge series. These are among its most recognizable product lines.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are audio brands, but they are not the company associated with the Flip and Charge speaker lines.

questions.question: Which Japanese camera brand makes the Lumix line?
questions.explanation_correct: Panasonic makes the Lumix line of digital cameras. Lumix is one of its best-known camera families.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are camera brands, but they do not make Lumix. They are separate manufacturers.

questions.question: Which platform, originally developed by Palm and later acquired and adapted by LG, is used on many LG smart TVs?
questions.explanation_correct: LG acquired webOS technology from HP in 2013 and developed it for smart TVs; Palm originally developed it.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Tizen is associated with Samsung, while Roku TV and Android TV belong to different TV platform ecosystems.

questions.question: Which handheld gaming PC is made by Valve?
questions.explanation_correct: Steam Deck is Valve's handheld gaming PC. It runs SteamOS and can play PC games in a portable form factor.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are handheld gaming PCs from other manufacturers. They are not Valve's device.

questions.question: Which Connectivity Standards Alliance smart-home standard can run over IP networks including Wi-Fi and Thread?
questions.explanation_correct: Matter is an application-layer interoperability standard that can use IP networks such as Wi-Fi and Thread.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thread is a network technology that Matter can use; Zigbee and Z-Wave are separate smart-home technologies.

questions.question: Which gaming headset manufacturer was acquired by Logitech in 2017 to strengthen its audio lineup?
questions.explanation_correct: Astro Gaming, known for its high-end headsets, was purchased by Logitech to expand its gaming peripheral brand portfolio.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Razer, Corsair, and SteelSeries operate as independent companies or are not owned by Logitech.

questions.question: Which action camera brand is known for the Tough line?
questions.explanation_correct: Olympus produced the Tough line, which includes rugged imaging products and cameras. It is the brand associated with that product family.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are action camera or imaging brands, but they are not the company associated with the Tough line.

questions.question: Which printer brand is also known for LaserJet?
questions.explanation_correct: HP is the company behind the LaserJet printer line. It is one of the most recognized printer brands worldwide.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are printer brands as well, but they are not the one associated with LaserJet.

questions.question: Which smart home security brand was acquired by Amazon?
questions.explanation_correct: Ring is the video doorbell and home security brand acquired by Amazon. It remains strongly associated with smart doorbells and cameras.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are all smart home security brands, but they were not acquired by Amazon.

questions.question: Which high-resolution audio format was developed by Sony and Philips?
questions.explanation_correct: SACD stands for Super Audio CD and was developed by Sony and Philips. It is a high-resolution optical audio format.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are audio formats, but they were not jointly developed by Sony and Philips as SACD was.

questions.question: Which smartphone brand is known for the Razr line?
questions.explanation_correct: Motorola is the brand associated with the Razr line of phones. The Razr name has been used on both classic and modern devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are phone brands, but they are not the one identified with the Razr line.

questions.question: Which phone brand is behind the Pixel line?
questions.explanation_correct: Google is the brand behind the Pixel smartphone line. Pixel devices are marketed directly under Google's name.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are major phone brands, but they do not produce the Pixel line.

questions.question: Which Apple tablet product family is being referred to here?
questions.explanation_correct: iPad is Apple's tablet product family. It refers specifically to Apple's line of tablet computers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are Apple products, but they are not the tablet family asked for.

questions.question: What property of a bistable E Ink display allows it to retain a page without continuously powering the display?
questions.explanation_correct: Bistable E Ink displays can retain a static image when power is removed; changing the image requires power.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A backlight, continuous refresh and refresh rate are not the property that retains the image without power.

questions.question: Which audio brand makes the QuietComfort headphone line?
questions.explanation_correct: Bose is the brand behind the QuietComfort headphone line. The series is especially known for active noise cancellation.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are audio brands, but they are not the company that produces QuietComfort headphones.

questions.question: Which smart TV platform was developed by Samsung?
questions.explanation_correct: Tizen is Samsung's operating system used on many of its smart TVs. It powers the TV interface, apps, and streaming features.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also TV platforms, but they are associated with different companies and ecosystems.

questions.question: In which direction does HDMI ARC primarily allow audio to travel?
options: From a TV to a compatible soundbar or receiver
From a camera to a printer only
From a Wi-Fi router to a phone
From a speaker to a camera sensor
questions.answer: From a TV to a compatible soundbar or receiver
questions.explanation_correct: Audio Return Channel can send audio from a television back to a compatible audio device over HDMI.
questions.explanation_incorrect: ARC is an HDMI audio return function, not a camera-printer, Wi-Fi or image-sensor link.

questions.question: Which Apple wireless audio protocol is used for streaming to speakers and TVs?
questions.explanation_correct: AirPlay is Apple's wireless protocol for sending audio and video to compatible devices. It is built into Apple's ecosystem.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are wireless technologies or casting standards, but they are not Apple's protocol.

questions.question: Which Garmin running and triathlon watch family includes the model numbered 965?
questions.explanation_correct: The Forerunner 965 is part of Garmin’s Forerunner family, which includes running and multisport watches.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Fenix, Venu and Instinct are other Garmin families, some of which also support fitness or multisport activities.

questions.question: Which modular Insta360 system uses a core, battery base and interchangeable lens modules?
questions.explanation_correct: ONE R is Insta360's modular action camera system. Its design allows different lens and core combinations.
questions.explanation_incorrect: GO 3, X3 and Ace Pro are other Insta360 models; ONE R used a modular design.

questions.question: Which Apple accessory is a wireless computer mouse?
questions.explanation_correct: Magic Mouse is Apple’s wireless mouse. Magic Trackpad is a separate pointing device.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Magic Keyboard is a keyboard, Magic Trackpad is a touchpad, and Apple Pencil is a stylus.

questions.question: Which electronics house brand does Walmart use for onn. streaming devices?
questions.explanation_correct: onn. is Walmart’s house brand for electronics including streaming devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Insignia, TCL and Element are separate electronics brands.

questions.question: Which name identifies Autel's consumer drone series?
questions.explanation_correct: Evo is Autel's consumer drone series. It includes several models aimed at hobbyist and enthusiast pilots.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are drone lines from other manufacturers, not Autel's Evo series.

questions.question: What abbreviation is commonly used for Sony's PlayStation VR headset line?
questions.explanation_correct: PSVR is the standard abbreviation for PlayStation VR. It refers to Sony's virtual reality headset line for PlayStation consoles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are similar-looking abbreviations, but they are not the commonly used name for PlayStation VR.

questions.question: What does active noise cancellation in compatible AirPods use to reduce external sound?
options: Microphones and an opposing audio signal
A mechanical shutter over the ear canal
questions.answer: Microphones and an opposing audio signal
questions.explanation_correct: Microphones detect sound and the device generates anti-noise to reduce unwanted sound.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The feature uses microphones and signal processing, not a GPS receiver, battery size alone or a mechanical shutter.

questions.question: Which company designs and markets the iPhone smartphone line?
questions.explanation_correct: Apple designs and markets the iPhone; manufacturing and assembly involve suppliers and contractors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Samsung, Sony, and Nokia are all consumer electronics companies, but they are not the manufacturer of the iPhone.

questions.question: What is the name of Sony's home video game console brand?
questions.explanation_correct: PlayStation is Sony's gaming console brand. It covers Sony's home video game consoles and ecosystem.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Xbox, Switch, and Dreamcast are console brands from other companies, not Sony's.

questions.question: What is optical image stabilization (OIS) designed to reduce in a camera?
options: Noise caused by the camera microphone
questions.explanation_correct: Optical stabilization moves a lens element or sensor to compensate for camera movement and reduce blur.
questions.explanation_incorrect: OIS concerns optical motion compensation, not file compression, metadata or microphone noise.

questions.question: What does HDR primarily extend in compatible video compared with standard dynamic range?
options: The range between dark and bright image detail
The physical size of the TV connector
The wireless range of a remote
questions.answer: The range between dark and bright image detail
questions.explanation_correct: High dynamic range video can represent a wider range of luminance; the visible result depends on the content and display.
questions.explanation_incorrect: HDR concerns image dynamic range, not channel count, connector size or remote-control range.

questions.question: What is the name of Apple's smart speaker line?
questions.explanation_correct: HomePod is Apple's line of smart speakers. It includes products designed to work with Apple's ecosystem.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Echo, Nest Audio, and Sonos One are all smart speakers, but they are made by other companies.

questions.question: What is Apple's home automation platform called?
questions.explanation_correct: HomeKit is Apple's smart home and home automation framework. It lets Apple devices control compatible accessories.
questions.explanation_incorrect: SmartThings, Alexa, and Matter are related to smart home control, but they are not Apple's platform.

questions.question: What is the name of Sony's handheld cassette player line?
questions.explanation_correct: Walkman is Sony's iconic portable audio player brand, originally famous for cassette playback. It became one of the best-known names in portable music devices.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Discman, boombox, and Minidisc are all audio-related terms, but they are not Sony's handheld cassette player line.

questions.question: Which high-definition optical disc format is specified and licensed by the Blu-ray Disc Association?
questions.explanation_correct: Blu-ray Disc is an optical format for high-definition audio/video and high-capacity data, licensed by the Blu-ray Disc Association.
questions.explanation_incorrect: DVD, HD DVD and LaserDisc are other optical formats, not the Blu-ray Disc Association’s Blu-ray format.

questions.question: Which Fujifilm line includes instant cameras and compatible self-developing film?
questions.explanation_correct: instax is Fujifilm’s instant photography line, covering cameras and film.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Polaroid is a separate instant-photography brand; Sure Shot and Canonet are Canon camera lines.

questions.question: Which Garmin outdoor multisport watch family includes models numbered 7 and 7 Pro?
questions.explanation_correct: The fēnix 7 belongs to Garmin’s fēnix family of multisport watches.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Forerunner, Venu and Instinct are other Garmin watch families and can also offer sports features.

questions.question: Which Autel Robotics drone family includes the Lite and Nano models?
questions.explanation_correct: The Autel Evo series is a direct competitor to DJI's consumer drone lineup.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mavic Air and Mini 3 are DJI products; Skydio is an American autonomous drone company.

questions.question: What is the name of Lenovo's handheld gaming PC line?
questions.explanation_correct: Legion Go is Lenovo's handheld gaming PC line. The other options are competing handheld gaming devices from other companies.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The distractors are all gaming handhelds, but they are not Lenovo's line. Each belongs to a different brand.

questions.question: What is the name of OnePlus's foldable phone?
questions.explanation_correct: OnePlus's foldable phone is called the Open. The other options are foldable phone names from other manufacturers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other choices are all foldable smartphones, but none is OnePlus's model name. They belong to rival brands.

questions.question: Which company marketed the XPS family of premium laptops?
questions.explanation_correct: XPS was Dell’s premium consumer computer family, including laptops.
questions.explanation_incorrect: ASUS markets ZenBook, Lenovo markets ThinkPad and HP markets Spectre; XPS was a Dell family.

questions.question: What was the name of Samsung's first generation of true wireless earbuds, released before the Galaxy Buds branding?
questions.explanation_correct: Gear IconX were Samsung's primary true wireless earbuds before the company unified its audio products under the Galaxy Buds name.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Pixel Buds are made by Google, FreeBuds are made by Huawei, and AirPods are made by Apple.

questions.question: How does an OLED display create an image?
options: Organic light-emitting pixels produce their own light
Liquid crystals create all light without a separate source
An electrophoretic page reflects ambient light
questions.answer: Organic light-emitting pixels produce their own light
questions.explanation_correct: OLED pixels emit light directly when driven electrically.
questions.explanation_incorrect: LCDs modulate light, CRTs use electron beams, and electrophoretic displays typically reflect ambient light.

questions.question: Which company is behind the Xbox gaming console family?
questions.explanation_correct: Microsoft is the company behind Xbox. The other options are companies associated with other game consoles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are also gaming companies, but they are not responsible for Xbox. Xbox is Microsoft's console family.

questions.question: What is the purpose of NFC in contactless payments?
options: High-power wireless charging across a room
Short-range wireless communication between a device and a reader
questions.answer: Short-range wireless communication between a device and a reader
questions.explanation_correct: NFC enables short-range communication used by compatible contactless payment devices and readers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: GPS, long-range power transfer and tape recording are not the contactless-payment role of NFC.

questions.question: Which company makes the WH-1000XM family of noise-cancelling headphones?
questions.explanation_correct: WH-1000XM models are Sony wireless headphones with active noise cancellation.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Bose, Sennheiser and Bowers & Wilkins make competing headphones, but WH-1000XM is a Sony model family.

questions.question: Which Bluetooth profile is designed for remote-control commands such as play and pause?
questions.explanation_correct: AVRCP specifies audio/video remote-control functions; A2DP addresses audio distribution.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A2DP streams audio; USB HID and HDMI ARC serve different interfaces and purposes.

questions.question: What is GoPro HyperSmooth designed to improve?
options: The optical zoom range of a lens
The amount of storage in a memory card
The charging speed of a battery
questions.explanation_correct: HyperSmooth is GoPro’s video-stabilization feature.
questions.explanation_incorrect: It is not an optical zoom mechanism, memory-card capacity upgrade or battery charger.

questions.question: What kind of computer accessory is the Logitech MX Master family?
questions.explanation_correct: MX Master is Logitech’s family of wireless computer mice.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The MX Master family does not name a printer, SSD or monitor line.

questions.question: What role can Thread play in a Matter smart-home setup?
options: A replacement for the device’s power supply
An IP-based mesh network carrying Matter messages
A video connector for a television
questions.answer: An IP-based mesh network carrying Matter messages
questions.explanation_correct: Matter can use Thread as an IP-based low-power mesh network; Matter and Thread perform different functions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thread is a wireless networking technology, not a video plug, image file or power supply.

questions.question: How do most reflective electronic-paper displays remain readable in ambient light?
options: They reflect external light rather than relying on a backlight
They require each pixel to emit light continuously
They use an electron beam to scan phosphors
They project an image onto a wall
questions.answer: They reflect external light rather than relying on a backlight
questions.explanation_correct: Reflective electronic-paper displays use ambient light; some readers add a front light for dark environments.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Self-emissive pixels and electron-beam phosphors describe other display approaches; a projector works differently.

questions.question: What distinguishes a standalone VR headset such as Meta Quest from a PC-tethered headset?
options: It can never contain a display
It needs a wired PC for every application
It works only as a television remote
It can run supported VR applications without a connected PC
questions.answer: It can run supported VR applications without a connected PC
questions.explanation_correct: A standalone headset contains computing hardware and can run compatible applications without a PC; some models also support PC connections.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A standalone headset has displays and need not be tethered for all apps; optional PC connectivity does not change that.

questions.question: Which satellite navigation system was developed by the United States and is used by many sports watches?
questions.explanation_correct: GPS is the U.S. Global Positioning System. Many Garmin watches can use GPS and, depending on the model, other satellite systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Galileo is European, GLONASS is Russian and BeiDou is Chinese.

questions.question: What recording technology did Sony’s recordable MiniDisc format use?
questions.explanation_correct: Recordable MiniDiscs use magneto-optical recording on a small disc inside a protective cartridge.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Recordable MiniDisc is a disc-based digital format, not cassette tape, a wax cylinder or a punch card.

questions.question: What is the Samsung mobile interface name used on Galaxy smartphones?
questions.explanation_correct: One UI is Samsung's current mobile interface used on Galaxy smartphones. It provides Samsung's software layer on top of Android.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are mobile interfaces from different eras or manufacturers. They are not Samsung's current interface name.

questions.question: What is SteamOS 3, the operating system supplied with the original Steam Deck, based on?
questions.explanation_correct: SteamOS 3 is a Linux distribution based on Arch Linux.
questions.explanation_incorrect: iOS, Tizen and ChromeOS are distinct operating systems; SteamOS 3 is Linux-based.

questions.question: What feature lets a compatible Ring video doorbell user speak with a visitor remotely?
questions.explanation_correct: Two-way audio uses the doorbell’s microphone and speaker with the app to support conversation.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A passive chime or optical disc drive does not provide remote two-way conversation.

questions.question: Which statement about a USB-C connector is correct?
options: USB-C specifies a single fixed data speed
The plug is reversible; supported features depend on the device and cable
All USB-C ports support Thunderbolt and video
Every USB-C cable can deliver 240 W
questions.answer: The plug is reversible; supported features depend on the device and cable
questions.explanation_correct: USB-C specifies the connector; supported protocols, speeds and power depend on the implementation.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The connector shape alone does not guarantee Thunderbolt, video, 240 W or one data speed.

questions.question: What does USB Power Delivery enable compatible devices to do?
options: Negotiate power delivery beyond basic USB power capabilities
Guarantee that every USB-C port supports video
Convert any USB cable into an optical fiber
Eliminate the need for a power source
questions.answer: Negotiate power delivery beyond basic USB power capabilities
questions.explanation_correct: USB Power Delivery allows supported devices to negotiate power; capabilities depend on the charger, device and cable.
questions.explanation_incorrect: USB PD does not itself guarantee video, replace a power source or convert a cable into fiber.

questions.question: What does a front light on a reflective e-reader do?
options: Provides all of the device’s internet connection
Illuminates the screen so it can be read in low light
questions.answer: Illuminates the screen so it can be read in low light
questions.explanation_correct: A front light illuminates a reflective display for reading in dim conditions; the image remains on the e-paper display.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A front light is illumination, not a video sensor, wireless network or conversion to self-emissive pixels.

questions.question: What does a smart thermostat primarily control in a compatible home system?
options: The storage format of a speaker
The refresh rate of a television
Heating or cooling according to a temperature setting
The optical focus of a security camera
questions.answer: Heating or cooling according to a temperature setting
questions.explanation_correct: A compatible smart thermostat can control heating or cooling and manage temperature settings.
questions.explanation_incorrect: It is not primarily a camera focus controller, audio format or television refresh-rate controller.

questions.question: Which brand makes the HERO camera line?
questions.explanation_correct: GoPro is the company behind the HERO action camera line. HERO is its signature series of rugged cameras.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are camera or imaging brands, but they do not make the HERO line. They are category-appropriate distractors.

questions.question: How do many optical wrist-worn heart-rate sensors estimate pulse?
options: They detect changes in reflected light from the skin
They directly measure blood pressure using a cuff
They record a continuous electrocardiogram from the wrist alone
They measure body weight with a scale
questions.answer: They detect changes in reflected light from the skin
questions.explanation_correct: Optical sensors use light and a detector to estimate pulse-related changes in blood flow; results can be affected by fit and motion.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Optical pulse sensing is different from cuff-based blood pressure measurement, ECG and weighing.

questions.question: In a Google Cast session, what does the sender device typically control?
options: The firmware used by every television
The chemical composition of the television screen
Media playback on a Cast-enabled receiver
questions.answer: Media playback on a Cast-enabled receiver
questions.explanation_correct: A Cast sender such as a phone sends playback commands to a compatible receiver such as a Chromecast or TV.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cast controls a media session; it does not physically alter a receiver’s hardware or screen chemistry.

questions.question: What happens when a compatible Fujifilm instax instant-film exposure is printed?
options: The film must be heated in a microwave oven
The image can appear only after scanning with a computer
The exposed film is ejected and develops into a visible print
The camera stores the image only on an optical disc
questions.answer: The exposed film is ejected and develops into a visible print
questions.explanation_correct: instax cameras expose compatible instant film, which is ejected and develops into a physical image.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Instant film produces a physical print and does not require a microwave, optical disc or computer scan.
